claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace defeats the arrival limb. All 34 driver fixes in EV-GPS-09105 sit 219.77 m from the pickup pin (min, mean and max distance are identical, and trace_distance_km is 0.0), and the derived arrival block records qualifying_fix_count of 0 — not one fix falls inside the 120 m arrival radius for this LARGE_VENUE pickup. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails, and under POL-NS-02 that failure entitles the rider to a full refund of the cancellation fee.

The in-geofence dwell is zero, so the waiting-period condition fails independently of the arrival limb. The driver's trace runs from 13:05:00 to cancellation at 13:10:30 with every fix at 0.0 km/h and zero distance travelled, but at 219.77 m from the pin, so the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0.0 seconds against the 300 second minimum for a LARGE_VENUE pickup — a 300 second shortfall. Under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages.

POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: all four limbs must hold and any single failure makes the fee unchargeable. I accept that limb (a) is met (trip_record arrived_at 13:05:20) and that limb (d) is met (terminated by the driver with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW), but limbs (b) and (c) both fail on the trace — no qualifying in-radius fix and no qualifying dwell. Two broken limbs, not one, defeat the charge.

This is the wrong-entrance case that POL-NS-03 governs. The driver was stationary — all fixes 0.0 km/h and trace_distance_km 0.0 — for 330 seconds, from 13:05:00 to the 13:10:30 cancellation, which is longer than the required 300 second dwell, at a point 219.77 m from the pickup pin: outside the 120 m POL-NS-02 arrival radius but comfortably inside the 400 m ceiling that is the whole test. On those numbers the driver did not arrive at the pickup point, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. POL-NS-05 is not engaged on these numbers (219.77 m is short of 300 m and the driver was not moving), and POL-NS-05 itself directs a driver stationary within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03.

Fault sits with the driver, so no compensation is payable to him. The chat log shows the rider naming the correct sub-location twice — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35 — while the driver had posted at 13:06:00 that he was at the mall taxi stand and never moved before cancelling at 13:10:30. That is the driver's own account on file: he waited at a mall entrance for the timer and did not move to Tower B. Under POL-NS-03(i), where the rider stated the correct entrance, block or tower in the chat log and the driver did not move to it before cancelling, the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation. The pin-ambiguity goodwill in limb (ii) is unavailable because it requires that neither party specified a sub-location, and the rider plainly did.

The driver cannot rebuild a dwell under POL-NS-06(i). The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-09105-01, is MISSING — status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, severity BLOCKING, weight_multiplier 0.0, payload null — so no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory covers this pickup road and waiting window, and limb (i) is unavailable on its own terms. I rely on that artifact for its absence, which is itself citable. In any event there is nothing to accumulate: the trace records run_count 0 and accumulated dwell 0.0 seconds, i.e. no in-geofence interval existed at all.

The rider was at the pin rather than absent, which answers the driver's account that he was left waiting for a rider who never came. The rider track in EV-GPS-09105 carries 16 fixes, every one of them 25.0 m from the pickup pin (min and mean identical) and therefore inside the 150 m rider-presence measure that POL-NS-04 limb (c) sets for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, with rider_qualifying_fix_count of 16 of 16. I put this forward as the presence test POL-NS-04 limb (c) defines rather than as a full limb (a)-to-(c) case, since the driver did reply at 13:06:00 within 120 seconds of the rider's first message; the rider's position also disposes of any suggestion that the rider's own absence explains the failed pickup.

The driver's compensation route is closed on this record. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the fee only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it; here POL-NS-01 fails at limbs (b) and (c), and both POL-NS-03 and POL-NS-06 displace it. No compensation is payable to the driver, and the rider should not be charged over so that any payout can be funded.

The rider presently carries the disputed charge and needs the cancellation-fee line refunded. EV-FARE-09105 records cancellation_fee 4.00 SGD, total_charged 4.00 SGD, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, against a LARGE_VENUE pickup in an RYDE_X vehicle — the 4.00 SGD figure the fee schedule prescribes for both those dimensions, so no amount is in issue, only whether it may be kept. Because this dispute is filed by the rider, a NO_ACTION outcome would leave that 4.00 SGD charge standing under POL-GEN-03; the rider needs the cancellation-fee line refunded and nothing else on the fare is in dispute.

claims.text: The trip_record 'arrived' marker is not a false arrival under POL-NS-05. At the 13:05:20 event the GPS trace places the driver stationary — 0.0 kph across all 34 fixes — at a mean 219.77 m from the pickup pin, which is inside POL-NS-05's 300 m ceiling and nothing like its 15 km/h motion trigger. POL-NS-05 therefore catches nothing: the driver is not to be written up as a false-arrival offender, the waiting period is not voided on that ground, and the case is decided under POL-NS-03.

The driver was at the venue and held his ground for the whole waiting window: 34 fixes at 0.0 kph, continuous from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30 — 330 seconds, more than the 300 second LARGE_VENUE minimum — all at 219.77 m from the pin. That is outside the 120 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for LARGE_VENUE but comfortably inside POL-NS-03's 400 m ceiling, which is precisely the wrong-entrance situation POL-NS-03 was written for. The fee is not chargeable under POL-NS-01 limb (b), and POL-NS-03 governs.

Both parties were on the same mall site, at different faces of it, and that is established from party statements in the chat log, not from geography: the driver posted at 13:06:00 'I am waiting at the mall taxi stand' and the rider answered at 13:06:35 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' This is the ordinary Singapore wrong-entrance case inside one LARGE_VENUE site carrying 3 registered pickup points, and the mislocation is between two signed points of that single venue.

On POL-NS-03(ii) the driver is owed the platform-funded pin-ambiguity goodwill of 50 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 2.00, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. The limb's second condition is satisfied outright: trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 3, above the threshold of 2. The first condition is satisfied as well, because neither party specified a sub-location: the rider's 13:05:05 message repeats the pickup pin's own label word for word ('Tower B ride-hail pickup'), and the driver's 13:06:00 message names only the mall taxi stand — neither party identified which of the three registered pickup points was to be used. The mislocation is therefore attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party.

POL-NS-04 does not apply and cannot strip the driver of compensation. The clause is conjunctive and limb (b) is not met: the rider's locating message at 13:05:05 drew the driver's reply at 13:06:00, 55 seconds later and well inside the 120 second window, and the exchange continued on both sides through the waiting window. The clause's target is an unanswered rider; that is not this trip, so the dispute stays under POL-NS-03 where the driver's goodwill payment is assessed.

Nothing in the bundle is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08, so the facts that decide this case carry full weight and none of the POL-NS-09 escalation triggers fires. The 13:05:20 'arrived' event sits within one 10 second sampling interval of the nearest fix (no clock skew, no gap, 34 fixes across the window); the chat log holds all 4 messages that trip_record.chat_message_count records, with no break in its msg_id sequence; and the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee exactly equals fee_schedule.resolution_rule for LARGE_VENUE (SGD 4.00) against RYDE_X (SGD 4.00). The driver's entitlement can be ruled on at full confidence.

The driver's pin-ambiguity goodwill is an independent payment under POL-GEN-03 and is not netted against anything else in the case: the SGD 2.00 is platform-funded and payable to the driver for the mislocation, and it stands on its own rather than being offset against the rider's side of the ledger.

ruling.explanation:
Rider, the full SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is refunded to you. Driver, the fee does not stand and no compensation is payable to you.

WHY THE FEE FALLS. POL-NS-01 requires all four conditions to hold, and two of them fail. Limb (b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius at or before the 13:05:20 'arrived' event; every one of the driver's 34 fixes sits 219.77 m from the Tower B pin, so there is not a single qualifying in-radius fix (derived qualifying_fix_count = 0). Limb (c) requires 300 seconds of continuous in-geofence dwell; the measured in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds. Both advocates read the trace the same way and I accept it.

WHICH CLAUSE GOVERNS. POL-NS-02 would give the rider a full refund for the absent in-radius fix, and POL-NS-06 would give the same result on the 300-second shortfall — its limb (i) accumulation is unavailable because EV-ADVIS-09105-01 is MISSING (status MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0). But POL-NS-02 expressly yields to POL-NS-03 where the driver was stationary for the required dwell within 400 m of the pin, and that is exactly this case: 330 seconds stationary (13:05:00 to the 13:10:30 cancellation) at 219.77 m. POL-NS-03 therefore governs, and its terms refund the cancellation fee to the rider in full.

WHO BEARS THE LOSS. The chat log shows the rider naming the correct sub-location — 'I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign' at 13:05:05 and 'That is the other entrance. Please come to Tower B.' at 13:06:35 — while the driver posted at 13:06:00 that he was at the mall taxi stand and never moved before cancelling. The driver's own statement on file confirms it: he waited at a mall entrance for the timer and did not move to Tower B. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation.

THE DRIVER'S GOODWILL CLAIM. POL-NS-03(ii) pays 50% pin-ambiguity goodwill only where NEITHER party specified a sub-location. The rider specified one, twice. The submission that 'Tower B ride-hail pickup' merely repeats the pin label does not survive the rider's second message, which expressly distinguishes the other entrance from Tower B. The SGD 2.00 goodwill is not payable, and the independence of payments under POL-GEN-03 does not arise because no such payment is owed.

POL-NS-04 does not apply, and I agree with the driver on that: the driver replied at 13:06:00, 55 seconds after the rider's 13:05:05 message, inside the 120-second window, so that clause neither exonerates the rider nor strips the driver. It does not help the driver here, because POL-NS-03(i), not POL-NS-04, is what removes his compensation.

POL-NS-05 is not engaged: 219.77 m is under its 300 m ceiling and the trace shows 0.0 kph throughout, so the arrival marker is not false and no false-arrival referral is made. POL-NS-07's compensation route is closed because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full; independently, the anti-farming check does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips).

INTEGRITY AND ESCALATION. Nothing in the bundle is impaired for policy purposes under POL-NS-08(a)-(d): no clock skew (the 13:05:20 event sits on a fix), no trace gap (34 fixes, max gap 0 s, rider track present), the chat log holds all 4 messages the trip record records with an unbroken sequence, and the SGD 4.00 fee equals the fee schedule for LARGE_VENUE / RYDE_X. EV-ADVIS-09105-01 at weight 0.0 can carry no fact; its absence is citable only as what makes POL-NS-06(i) unavailable. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires (no unresolved contradiction, no counterparty dispute history, no anti-farming trip, rider no_show_disputes_30d = 0), so this is decided at the evidence's own weight rather than escalated. No profile field was used as a ground of decision (POL-GEN-01).
